base_prompt:
A high-end stylised 3D animated feature film, cinematic and colourful, family comedy-adventure tone, expressive cartoon character animation with squash-and-stretch, detailed fur and fabric, soft global illumination, rich saturated colour, shallow depth of field, anamorphic widescreen framing, smooth professional camera work.
Setting: deep space with a vast star field, the planet curving below, the Tomkin-Mobile soaring with wings spread. Lighting: crisp starlight and sun flares.
In the shot: Duggie, an enormous, lovable Golden Retriever with shining coin-gold fur smeared with bog mud and river silt, one blade of grass stuck to his head, extraordinarily long floppy ears that flap like wings, huge soulful golden-brown eyes, a giant wagging tail, and a small swarm of cartoon flies circling his head in tight synchronised formation; Gary, a tiny cartoon housefly with big shiny compound eyes, smug self-satisfied angled wings, pulling a minuscule wheeled suitcase; the Tomkin-Mobile, a sleek, aggressive, low-slung racing car with the armoured bulk of a naval battleship, mirror-polished chrome and copper panels, retractable feathered metal wings that fold like a barn owl's, a tailpipe that puffs lavender-coloured bubbles, and a roof rack on top.
Camera: Exterior on Duggie riding the roof, lighthouse far below.
Action: Duggie rides on the roof, ears streaming, as the lighthouse comes into view far below on its cliff.
Dialogue: Duggie (goofy, warm, slightly gravelly young male voice; in FAST mode a breathless machine-gun stutter of words; in SLOW mode a deep, stretched, slowed-down drawl as if recorded at quarter speed, FAST mode) says: "I CAN SEE THE LIGHTHOUSE it's POINTY and SHINY I LOVE ALL OF YOU and GARY LOVES YOU TOO!"
Sound effects: wind rush, tiny smug buzz, ambience of muffled rumble of the Meow-Drive.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
extension_prompt:
Continue this exact shot seamlessly: same characters, same designs, same setting, same lighting and same 3D animated style (Duggie, Gary the Fly).
Action: Duggie switches to slow motion; on the tip of his nose sits Gary, with his tiny suitcase, waving.
Dialogue: Tomkin (crisp, rapid-fire, precise male tenor with a clipped British accent; superior, exasperated, always certain he is the only rational being in the room, shrieking from inside the car) says: "Gary is still here?!" Duggie (goofy, warm, slightly gravelly young male voice; in FAST mode a breathless machine-gun stutter of words; in SLOW mode a deep, stretched, slowed-down drawl as if recorded at quarter speed, SLOW mode) says: "Gary... packed... his... suitcase... again..."
Sound effects continue: wind rush, tiny smug buzz.
Audio: dialogue and sound effects only, no background music, no narrator other than the characters speaking. No subtitles, no captions, no readable on-screen text.
